name: Zach Hudson

bio.statement: Hudson's official page says he chairs the House Committee on Higher Education & Workforce Development.
bio.excerpt: I am the Chair of the House Committee on Higher Education & Workforce Development

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Hudson member page

bio.statement: His campaign site says he is a teacher and former Troutdale City Council member.
bio.excerpt: I'm a teacher and a former Troutdale City Council member.

bio.statement: His campaign About page says he has substitute-taught locally while the legislature is not in session.
bio.excerpt: At the moment I substitute-teach at local schools while the legislature is not in session.

positions.statement: His campaign issues page says education funding should cover counselors, school nurses and mental health professionals as well as classroom teachers.
positions.excerpt: funding not only classroom teachers, but counselors, school nurses, mental health professionals

positions.statement: His issues page says he opposes fossil fuel infrastructure development and supports incentives for green energy technology.
positions.excerpt: I oppose the development of fossil fuel infrastructure and I support incentives to develop green energy technology.

positions.statement: His issues page says he will not vote for cuts to PERS and supports workers' right to unionize.
positions.excerpt: I support unions and I support the right of workers to unionize.

positions.statement: His issues page says Oregon should welcome all immigrants, including asylum seekers and refugees.
positions.excerpt: Oregon should be a welcoming place to all immigrants, including asylum seekers and refugees.

positions.statement: His issues page says he supports regulating prices of prescription drugs such as insulin as a public good.
positions.excerpt: Prescription drugs such as insulin should be seen as a public good, and prices should be regulated accordingly.

positions.statement: His issues page says he supports a ban on military-style weapons and high-capacity magazines.
positions.excerpt: I support a ban on military-style weapons and high-capacity magazines.

positions.statement: His issues page says he supports renter protections and public-private partnerships to increase affordable housing supply.
positions.excerpt: I support renter protections and public-private partnerships that increase the supply of affordable housing.
